caption: The drawing depicts a mechanical device mounted on a rectangular wooden block. The device is primarily composed of metal with a dark, iron-like finish and is attached vertically to the wooden block. There is a distinct funnel-shaped top with an inscription or maker's mark oval-shaped on the front, and a curved metal crank extending outward to the right, ending in a cylindrical wooden handle with a natural light brown color. The wooden block has visible wood grain and is secured with metal screws. The background of the drawing is plain and off-white, providing contrast to the device and wood, which are the central focus of the composition. The artist's signature, "M.A. Bevier," appears in small lettering to the right of the object.
title: Coffee Mill
